The fun doesn’t stop once summer is over at Mactaquac Provincial Park! Our park is open year-round so you can enjoy all of our outdoor activities this winter!

Grab your toboggan and zip down one of our 2 groomed sliding hills, amongst the Top 10 in Canada. Skate around our beautiful ponds or try our Forest Skate Trail. Cross-country ski on 7 km of groomed trails, both classic and skate ski, or snowshoe at various locations in the park. Winter walkers can follow a well-maintained trail that begins at the park's main gate and continues through Campground 1, leashed dogs are welcome. Enjoy the park camping experience all year round by spending the night in your tent or in one of our rustic shelters (reservations required). Snowmobile enthusiasts can ride to and in the park on our safe, groomed trails.

The sliding hills and skating ponds are lit nightly until closing. Snowshoes, sliding tubes, helmets, and fat bikes are available for rent at the park - first come, first served. Please see our "Dates and Rates" page for fees.

The park administration office is open daily from 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. throughout the winter. Please consult the most current conditions report for all winter activities and rental availabilities on our [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/parcmactaquacpark/) or [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/parcmactaquacpark/) page, or call ahead.

##### Mactaquac Provincial Park Campground

Mactaquac Provincial Park’s campgrounds offer tent sites, RV sites, and roofed accommodations for overnight stays. Campers can enjoy the outdoors, gather around a campfire, and take part in seasonal park activities.

Reserve your campsite today!
